verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler turns components into "lean, tightly optimized JavaScript" that does "minimal work in the browser" and updates the DOM directly ([svelte-docs-1], [svelte-docs-4], [svelte-gh-1]). That design directly targets a small runtime footprint. A hands-on migration report from React also cites a clear bundle-size improvement ([svelte-comm-8]). missing for 10: no evidence on runtime dependency count or how dependency-light the output is, nothing on reducing supply-chain risk, and no published bundle-size figures or benchmarks.
